title: Installment Frequency in Force and Installment Periods for TRICARE Select Drafts
content:
**Clause.** For a one-time bank draft on a fee-bearing **TRICARE Select** enrollment, a change of installment frequency takes effect from the next installment period, so an installment is owed at the frequency in force, the one installments are being charged at: where an annual installment has been charged for a coverage period starting in the calendar year of the payment date, on or before that date, the frequency in force is annual; otherwise, where a quarterly installment has been charged for a coverage period starting in the calendar quarter of the payment date, on or before that date, it is quarterly; otherwise, where a monthly installment has been charged for a coverage period starting in the month of the payment date, on or before that date, it is monthly; and where none has been, it is the frequency the enrollment has elected. At the frequency in force an installment period is the calendar year for an annual installment, which covers twelve months, the calendar quarter for a quarterly installment, which covers three, and otherwise, for a monthly installment, the calendar month, which covers one.

## Reading the fee account

| Charges on the fee account | Frequency in force | Installment period | Months it covers |
|---|---|---|---|
| an annual charge for a period starting in the payment date's calendar year, on or before the payment date | annual | calendar year | 12 |
| no such annual charge; a quarterly charge for a period starting in the payment date's calendar quarter, on or before it | quarterly | calendar quarter | 3 |
| neither; a monthly charge for a period starting in the payment date's month, on or before it | monthly | calendar month | 1 |
| none of these | the frequency the enrollment has elected | as for that frequency | 12, 3 or 1 |

A calendar year holds 4 calendar quarters (January, April, July and October starts) and 12 calendar months.

## Hypothetical illustrations (payment on 2026-08-05)

- An annual charge has been made for the 2026 calendar year and the enrollment has since elected quarterly installments: the frequency in force is annual, so the installment period is the 2026 calendar year.
- A monthly charge for August 2026 exists and no annual or quarterly charge for 2026: the frequency in force is monthly.
- No charge falls in 2026 at all and the enrollment has elected annual installments: the frequency in force is annual.
